verdict.rationale: Exa is a hosted search and retrieval API built on its own proprietary index, and nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core search engine or index. Self-hosting is a fair question for a search platform, so the axis applies. The open-source MCP server (exa-docs-31) and the JS SDK are only client-side adapters that call Exa's hosted API, so they earn no credit here.
